name: Ferret Flames
card_text: If the combined ATK of all face-up monsters your opponent controls is higher than your LP: Make your opponent shuffle face-up monsters they control into the Deck (their choice), except monsters with 0 ATK, so that the combined ATK of the remaining monsters they control becomes less than or equal to your LP.
available_set: STRUCTURE DECK: LEGEND OF THE CRYSTAL BEASTS
